title: Sleep disruption model — nighttime interventions, chronic stress, and dawn amplification

caption.scope: The sleep disruption model turns nighttime player actions into a next-day physiology effect. Interventions between 22:00 and 07:00 create awakening events, accumulate lost sleep, amplify the pre-morning dawn term while the night is still active, and at 07:00 convert sleep loss into pending chronic stress that drains into chronicStressLevel and raises insulin resistance.
